pr_title: Fix custom Ctrl-Space shortcut in Script Editor adds a space
pr_body:
- Fixes #94032

It seems that `get_tree()->get_root()->set_input_as_handled()` was not called in `EditorNode::shortcut_input` for some shortcuts.

It's not the most beautiful code, but I'm not sure how to make it better!!

Edit: was wrong issue.

issue_context.title: Custom shortcut Ctrl-Space in Script Editor add a space
issue_context.body:
### Tested versions

Godot v4.3.beta.mono (27e375920)

### System information

Godot v4.3.beta.mono (27e375920) - Windows 10.0.22631 - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (NVIDIA; 31.0.15.3742) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-11600KF @ 3.90GHz (12 Threads)

### Issue description

I customized the shortcut "Completion Query" for Ctrl-Alt-Space and used Ctrl-Space for "Toggle Last Opened Bottom Panel".
When the Script Editor is focus and I press Ctrl-Space, the Bottom panel opens/closes but a space is added in the script.
What is strange is that Ctrl-J does not produce this error.


https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/81109165/15db1017-798e-4ddf-a685-2943c792f715




### Steps to reproduce

- Change the "Completion Query" shortcut for something else.
- Change the "Toggle Last Opened Bottom Panel" shortcut for "Ctrl-Space".
- Open a script.
- Press Ctrl-Space.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Any project will do.
